intro: Allegiance to the Old Gods is a Horde quest initiated by recovering a waterlogged message from the naga inside Blackfathom Deeps. Delivering the note to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost uncovers a sinister ritual plot unfolding deep within the flooded ruins of Blackfathom Deeps.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Some poor handwriting is scrawled on the crumpled up note:
"Yes, tell all the priestesses to bring the crystals to me. The water elemental spirits are strong within them and they will aid our aquamancers greatly in their own summonings.

By controlling the power within the crystals, we will appease Aku'Mai. One day we will have enough power to bring Aku'Mai back to us and the world will return to its greatest era! An era of rule by the Old Gods!"

clips.title: Progress
paras: Yes, friend? What is it you need? There is still much I must learn about the crystals the naga are gathering.

clips.title: Completion
paras: This is interesting indeed. I am glad you have brought it to my attention.
Now we have a name for our troubles... Lorgus Jett.
